# Pull Request Template

Thanks for contributing. Please review [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) before requesting review.

Please describe any docs change you made and add a dated entry in `docs/changes-log/` with format `YYYY-MM-DD.md` when
relevant.

## Checks

- [ ] Builds clean without errors or warnings
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated where needed
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## General Notes

- [ ] Does not introduce unnecessary external services
- [ ] Does not require paid tools to run core project workflows
